selection: Development validation only, physical-configuration balanced; report legacy validation separately
predictions: Frozen before any test FDS submission; identical physical inputs across seed replicas; seed is not a model input
metrics: integrated heat release history relative L1
percent_denominator: Corresponding FDS magnitude, ambient20C for temperature rise; null if denominator vanishes. Retain absolute errors and reference magnitudes for audit.
aggregation: Average seeds within each physical configuration, then average configurations; report medians and all individual rows. Separately assess predictions against three-seed ensemble means for four repeated configurations, plus FDS run-to-run heat/peak spread.
alignment: Linearly interpolate reference FDS fields onto frozen nominal2s prediction times; no changing predictions or extrapolation
animations: Select first test configuration at each height in4/6/8/10m, before reading results. FDS/snapshot/hybrid, shared scales and view; retain weak-burning examples in numerical report.
interpretation: Single generic cone family, fixed domain and mesh; not field validation or multi-tree composition
